fields.statement: At b6365ae6 (review cycle 3 fix): go test -count=1 ./internal/textref passes (TestFind, TestResolve, TestResolveLiteralFullID, TestFormat); FuzzRoundTrip and FuzzStoredRoundTrip each ran 30s (1.1M and 1.3M execs) with no failure; go vet and gofmt clean; go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/text-refs passes. Probes on a scratch copy of the package: references start only at text start or after whitespace, ( or [ (not after x or {); @ABC (3 chars) is no reference, @ABCD and @01M6 are; @abc--def is none; darin@hey.com, checkout@v7, '@key' hold none; @@ is a literal @, never a reference. Resolve returns @@{<full ID>} (missing and live IDs alike) as unresolved with Escaped set and an unmapped @{<full ID>} as unresolved without it, writes both as @<full ID> without braces, which Format shows as @@<full ID> (no reference); @@{ID} still stores the literal @{ID}, shown @@{ID}; @{BOGUS} is unresolved with its offset while @{<live ID>} resolves. Format shows a live stored ID as @<handle>, a retired or unknown one as @{<full ID>}, stored '@{ID}', '@{BOGUS}', '@{<full ID>}' as @@{...}, and @word as @@word. The diff of b6365ae6 adds Decision text-ref-stored-escape, amends this leaf's statement and acceptance to match the code, updates the guide, and checks the usage code in text-refs-write.txtar.
